name: Hyphn
subtitle: Your iPhone as your PC's webcam, locally.
description: Hyphn turns your iPhone into a 4K60 webcam for Windows and sends your photos to your PC, over Wi-Fi or cable, with no account and no cloud.

apps.name: Hyphn
apps.subtitle: iPhone webcam and photo drop for Windows.
apps.localizedDescription: Pair with the Hyphn app on your Windows PC by QR code. Cam: your iPhone becomes a webcam for Discord, Teams and OBS, up to 4K60 HEVC. Drop: send photos and videos to your PC in original quality. Everything stays on your local network.

versions.localizedDescription: Automatic updates on the PC and in SideStore. Fixes: Russian translation, long waiting messages shrink to fit, settings switches.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Hyphn uses the camera to read the PC's QR code and to become your PC's webcam.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Hyphn sends the photos and videos you choose to your PC, in their original quality.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Hyphn talks to your PC on your local network, directly and encrypted.
